about_the_game:
They did it!
Despite your warnings, they did it! They are all guilty: the King and Queen, the Rook, the Bishop, and the Knight. There’s no turning back and no time for forgiveness. Betrayal has sealed your fate: you must finish them all. Without mercy.

In this 2D real-time adventure, you take on the role of the Black King in a quest for vengeance across perilous environments. Explore the world freely, use your surroundings to your advantage, and decide how to proceed: confront, avoid, or stealthily observe your enemies. Listen to their conversations, destroy their defenses, and interrogate them to uncover the hidden truth behind the conspiracy.

The game is inspired by chess to shape its setting and characters. But beware: there are no turns here. You must adapt in real time to your enemies’ attacks… and it’s you alone against all of them.
